page: Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is an Edsv6-series virtual machine configured with 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at 4.2 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 32.0 GB per core. Additionally, the instance includes 7559 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is Premium Storage capable.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory and processing capabilities. The server achieves a strong memory bandwidth read-only large block speed of 238.84 GB/sec and a write speed of 137.13 GB/sec. Geekbench testing shows strong single-core (2086.0) and multi-core (16779.0) performance, alongside strong results in image processing and text processing. In terms of web serving, it delivers a strong static web serving throughput of 44.43 GB/sec. For AI workloads, the processor's AMX instructions support strong LLM inference speeds, processing 2558.78 tokens/sec for a small 135M model and 179.21 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E128-32ds_v6 offers high resource density by combining a massive 1 TB memory footprint and a spacious 7.5 TB local NVMe SSD with a moderate 32-vCPU allocation. This resource distribution makes it highly suitable for memory-intensive and storage-heavy applications without requiring the expense of a higher vCPU tier. The server is well-suited for large-scale databases, in-memory caching, data analytics, software compilation, and web serving workloads.
